calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory,
       SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
       MIN(f.sale_date) AS first_d, MAX(f.sale_date) AS last_d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY units DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, COUNT(*) AS n,
         COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS nd
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(m.sale_date, r.business_date) AS d, m.units, r.units_sold, m.receipts, r.receipts AS rpt_receipts, m.n, m.nd
FROM mine m FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') r ON r.business_date=m.sale_date
WHERE m.units IS DISTINCT FROM r.units_sold OR m.receipts IS DISTINCT FROM r.receipts OR m.n<>m.nd
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku
LIMIT 3
